title: Data analysis method and apparatus

pse.problem: Determining clients for federated learning based on their feedback evaluation of models, without sending local data to another client.
pse.solution_function: The server MTLF sends a first model, receives first accuracy evaluation information from candidate client MTLFs, and determines client MTLFs participating in federated learning based on the evaluation information. If a difference between evaluated values fed back by any two of the client MTLFs is less than or equal to a threshold, they are considered for federated learning.
pse.solution_structure: Server MTLF and N candidate client MTLFs
pse.solution_implementation: The server MTLF sends a first model evaluation request message with the first model to each candidate client MTLF. The clients evaluate the model using local data and send back the first accuracy evaluation information in response.
pse.effect: Improving prediction accuracy of models trained through federated learning by selecting client MTLFs whose distribution of local data is similar
